text.title: Growth Viral Loops Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from the product's sharing moment to the loop spec: name the inherent share event, instrument the five joinable loop events, decompose K into invites per user and accept rate over two cycles, measure cycle time from timestamps and run the projection, anchor the K target to baseline and benchmark, map the invitee path and its friction experiments, design any incentive on activation, clear consent and disclosure and validate.

step.name: name-the-inherent-share-event
step.input: The product's collaborative or outbound actions; `templates/loop-anatomy.md.j2`.
step.action: Fill the anatomy worksheet, pick the action with the highest frequency where sharing creates value for the inviter, and record it as `primary_loop.share_event` with `kind: inherent` and `value_to_inviter` in `templates/growth-viral-loops.spec.md.j2`. Any invite modal or referral page goes into `secondary_loop` with its own K.
step.decision-gate: No product action involves another person: skip per 06-decision-tree.xml; a bolt-on referral page is not a primary loop (r-share-moment-is-inherent).

step.name: instrument-the-five-joinable-events
step.action: Define `events[]`: invite_shown, invite_sent, invite_opened, invite_accepted, invitee_activated, each keyed on invite_id and inviter_user_id. Verify one invite can be followed across all five rows. Record `retention.invitee_d30` next to `organic_d30` once a cohort is 30 days old.
step.decision-gate: Events cannot be joined per invite: the spec's first experiment is instrumentation and no K target is set (r-loop-events-instrumented).

step.name: decompose-k-over-two-cycles
step.input: Joined event rows over at least two full cycles.
step.action: Compute `invites_per_active_user` (invite_sent per active user, with window and sample) and `accept_rate_per_invite` (invite_accepted / invite_sent, with window and sample); set `k_factor.k` to their product to three decimals and `cycles_measured`.
step.decision-gate: Only an asserted K exists: reject it; the spec carries no K without i and c behind it (r-k-factor-decomposed).

step.name: measure-cycle-time-and-run-the-projection
step.input: Timestamps of the inviter's invite_sent and the invitee's first invite_sent; `templates/loop-projection.py`.
step.action: Record `cycle_time.days` as the median send-to-first-send interval with `sample_size`. Run `project(starting_users, K, cycle_days, days)` and record `projection` with `ignores_churn: true`.
step.decision-gate: Cycle time estimated rather than measured, or a projection without the churn caveat: not accepted (r-cycle-time-measured-and-projected).

step.name: anchor-the-k-target
step.input: `k_factor.k`; a category benchmark with a named source.
step.action: Set `k_target.current_k` = `k_factor.k`, `benchmark` with `range_low`, `range_high`, `source`, and `target_k` with `kind`: self_sustaining only when the target is 1.0 or more and current K is at least 0.4, otherwise increment.
step.decision-gate: Target above 1.0 from a baseline below 0.4: rewrite as an increment target (r-k-target-anchored-to-baseline).

step.name: map-the-invitee-path-and-friction-experiments
step.input: Funnel conversions from first exposure to the artifact to an activated account.
step.action: List `invitee_path[]` (at most three steps, each with measured `conversion`). For each experiment record `target_step`, `current_conversion` (the step's) and `expected_conversion`. Add at least one experiment that shortens cycle time if the median is long.
step.decision-gate: More than three steps: the first experiment removes steps; an experiment that names no step is not graded (r-friction-steps-capped).

step.name: design-any-incentive-on-activation
step.action: If the loop pays anything, fill `incentive`: `referrer_reward`, `invitee_reward`, `trigger_milestone` (the activation event), `window_days`, `max_rewards_per_referrer_per_12_months`, `self_referral_block` (device_fingerprint, ip, payment_instrument), `excludes_existing_and_past_users: true`. Otherwise set `incentive` to null.
step.decision-gate: Reward on signup, no cap, or no self-referral block: the incentive does not launch (r-reward-on-activation-not-signup).

step.name: clear-consent-and-disclosure-and-validate
step.input: The compliance checklist in `templates/referral-program.md.j2`; the invite message and landing page copy.
step.action: Set `consent_and_disclosure.recipient_source` (addresses entered by the inviter, or a consented import), `casl_express_consent: true`, `gdpr_lawful_basis`, and `compensation_disclosure` (message, landing_page or both whenever `incentive` is not null). Run `scripts/validate-growth-viral-loops.py --file` on the spec.
step.decision-gate: Contact import without consent or an undisclosed paid referral: the spec is not shippable (r-referral-consent-and-disclosure).

list.item: Spec validates via `scripts/validate-growth-viral-loops.py` with no violation.
K is shown as i x c on joined events over two cycles, cycle time comes from timestamps, and the projection is reproducible with loop-projection.py.
The invitee path has at most three steps with an experiment per bottleneck; any incentive pays on activation and is disclosed.
